scope: Pinned HyperFrames 0.8.139 compile/archive/rebuild and actual standalone Chromium ESM/resource evaluation; not installed Electron or arbitrary ESM ecosystem coverage
semantics: Recognize lexical const aliases/chains of URL, globalThis, import.meta and url, including object destructuring and static string properties
Respect function/parameter, var, class, catch, loop and temporal-dead-zone binding semantics; unknown and mutable aliases remain untouched
Only an actual captured native URL constructor receives declared-resource argument conversion; custom constructors and nonconstructors retain their original arguments and evaluation behavior
Evaluate callee and arguments once in original order; preserve native prototype, constructor and static identity without replacing globals
Keep executable modules and image/font/media resources separate; reject undeclared dependencies, path escapes, external schemes and forged data URLs
Retain historical compile-time literal admission for direct unbound new URL syntax; it is not full compatibility with authored global URL replacement
Adapter identity changes require explicit compile of old archives rather than rewriting their locks

regressions: const alias image and font loads

uncovered: Mutable aliases, arbitrary parameter/data flow, default/array destructuring and dynamic property names
Classic-script dynamic imports and query-specific import-map scopes
Native hierarchical resource URLs and all HTTP pathname/query behavior; resource URLs are closed in-memory data URLs
Full authored audio graphs, all ESM ecosystems, full MV and installed Electron acceptance
